settings.heading: High-end everyday dressing, without the discomfort.
settings.text:
Herloom began with one question: why is the perfect shirt so hard to find? So we make nothing else. Premium natural fabrics, considered cuts, and a fit made for you, one piece at a time.

Whatever the occasion, there is a Herloom piece for that mood.

settings.heading: Made for you. One piece at a time.
settings.text: Every shirt is cut and stitched by hand only after it's ordered.
